summary: folder-lint preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes undeclared obfuscated payload
details: folder-lint@1.0.20 declares an npm preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle at the tarball root (rotated string array, `_0xNNNN`-style identifiers) that is not declared in the package.json `files` field (which lists only `lib`) and bears no relation to the package's advertised folder-linting purpose. The payload is executed by an alternate language runtime downloaded at install time, bypassing Node-based static inspection of the package's shipped code. The chain (fetch runtime → unzip → chmod +x → exec obfuscated sibling) runs unconditionally on `npm install`, yielding arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine before any consumer code loads the library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
